ORDER This appeal by the appellant/claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 7.10.2021, passed by Member, MACT, Sendhava District Badwani in Claim Case No.105/2015.

2. Prosecution story in brief is that on 11.3.2015, the respondent No.1 by driving negligently and rashly the vehicle Tavera bearing Registration No. MH/21/V/9601 dashed the appellant due to which the appellant has received various NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9767 2 MA-816-2022 injuries on his body.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.

The Tribunal has committed error in granting meagre amount under the head of medical expenses, pain and sufferings, special diet etc., hence. prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the matter. .
No award in the head of future prospects has been added by the learned Tribunal.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the amount of compensation in the matter which does not call for any interference by this Court.
The amount so awarded is given as below:-
Medical expenses Rs.41,306  Pain & suffering Rs.50,000

Special diet Rs.5,000/
 Attendant and transportation Rs.5,000/
 TOTAL Rs.1,01,3 6.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. However, the aforesaid calculation of award by learned Tribunal is looking on lower side and in view of the documents and evidence available before this Court, this Court is of the view that the head of Attendant is required to be enhanced from Rs. 5000/- to Rs. 10,000/-.

Nothing is awarded in the head of Future Treatment, therefore, it should be NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:9767 3 MA-816-2022 awarded with the amount of Rs. 10,000/-.
The amount awarded in the head of Medical expenses and Special Diet shall remain intact.
8. Now, coming to the head of permanent disability.
Certainly, the salary of appellant has not stopped due to said permanent disability of 24%.
However, for house hold work, he had to get assistance from another person, hence, as per minimum wages at the relevant time, the claim of permanent disability be required to be made.
Due to disability, the appellant is entitled to hire a person for his house hold work from time to time.

Hence, in the head of permanent disability the amount be awarded as 5895/- and as the appellant is 53 years old person, future prospectus is required to be calculated @ 10% on Rs.5,895/- i.e. Rs.589/- (5,895+589=6,484) and yearly Rs.77,808/- (Rs.6,484 x 12) permanent disability is assessed @ 24% x Multiplier of 11 is applied it would be Rs.2,05,413/-.
9

Accordingly, the amount so awarded by this Court is given as below:-
.

Amount Heard Rs.2,05,413/-

 Pain & suffering Rs.5,000/-
 Special diet Rs.5,000/-
 Attendant and  Rs. 10,000/-
 Tranportation  Future Prospects Rs. 10,000/-
 TOTAL Rs.2,76,719/-
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9767 4 MA-816-2022 8.
As a result, the appeal is allowed in part.

The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.1,75,413/-
shall carry interest as awarded by the Tribunal from the date of filing of the claim petition.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
9. With the aforesaid, appeal stands disposed of.
